The BelanQora Difference

More than a design tool. A thoughtful partner for your next step.

Great platforms give businesses choices. BelanQora focuses on turning your ideas into finished, cohesive marketing materials—with a clearly defined scope and a person to contact.

DIY Design · Canva

Tools vs. done-for-you

Canva offers templates and design tools, including a free plan. BelanQora is for owners who would rather brief a creative service and receive ready-to-use designs.

Freelance Marketplace · Fiverr

Browsing vs. a defined package

Fiverr offers many independent freelancers, reviews and packages. BelanQora offers a small, consistent set of packages with clear deliverables and revision limits.

Website Builder · Wix

Build a site vs. market your business

Wix helps businesses create websites. BelanQora's current packages focus on promotional visuals and copy—not website hosting or full website development.

Trust is earned through the details.

Privacy, Security & Transparency

We value your trust. We collect only the contact and project information needed to respond to inquiries and deliver requested services. Access to customer records is restricted, and we use security safeguards to reduce unauthorized access. No online system can be guaranteed 100% secure.

When online payments become available, checkout will be handled by Stripe; BelanQora will not request or store your full card number or card security code on this website. Package prices, scope, revisions, timing, applicable taxes or extra fees, and cancellation/refund terms will be disclosed for your review before you commit to an order. No surprise charges.

This website may be a preview while checkout and client accounts are being tested. Do not submit sensitive personal, financial, or confidential business information through general contact or chat forms. For privacy questions or requests concerning your information, email belanqoraofficialsite@gmail.com.
